author: NASS
description:
Step back in time and experience Paris in the 1920s like never before, From the Grands Boulevards to the Latin Quarter, via Parc Monceau and Île de la Cité

This brand-new 2026 restoration brings historic footage of Paris to life using advanced powered restoration and colorization techniques. Every scene has been meticulously restored, enhanced, stabilized, and colorized by hand to achieve the most authentic and immersive result possible.

Compared my 2022 version, this new restoration introduces a dramatically higher level of realism thanks to modern diffusion-based restoration methods, New semantic colorization, and the use of thousands of historical reference images.

📽️ Technologies & Techniques Used:
• Diffusion-based video restoration
• New semantic colorization only for the ambiance (not historically accurate)
• Manually colorized keyframes (to establish accurate ambiance and color consistency (not historically accurate)
• Advanced frame reconstruction to FHD

title: Paris 1920s – Advanced Colorization (New Version 2026) with Sound Design
